faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 October 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 2 Senior-PAT, 3 Project Associate-I, 1 Project Assistant-II, 1 YP-I/Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 27 October 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: K. N. Kaul Block, CSIR-NBRI, Rana Pratap Marg, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior-PAT: maximum 40 years; Project Associate-I: maximum 35 years; Project Assistant-II: maximum 35 years; YP-I/Project Associate-I: maximum 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 42,000+HRA for Senior-PAT, (a) 31,000 + HRA for NET/GATE qualified (b) 25,000 + HRA for others for Project Associate-I, Rs. 20,000 + HRA for Project Assistant-II, Rs. 25,000 +HRA PM for YP-I/Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q8. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters / Integrated Masters in Natural/Agricultural/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Environment Science/Plant Sciences/Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Physics/Chemistry/Botany/Zoology or Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology or B.Sc./3 years Diploma. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
